description: Run a Slop Curriculum lab’s exact checks on a draft, before handing it in on learn.slopped.site: a tiny game spec, a sound recipe or pack (rendered and measured), a motion shot (rendered frame by frame), a SKILL.md, a tool definition, a verb or juice table, or a plan. The same code the lab judge runs; no model, nothing stored. Use when a learner wants to know whether their JSON or file passes before they submit. Returns each exact row (met or not, with a note) and lists the rows only the lab’s judge marks.

draft.description: The draft exactly as it would be pasted into the lab: JSON, a SKILL.md, or text.

module.description: The module whose lab this draft is for (see list_curriculum), e.g. "ship-a-tiny-game", "a-sound-is-a-recipe", "camera-moves", "skills".

prior.description: Earlier labs’ answers in the same pathway, by format, for the rows that compare with them (e.g. a sound must be for an event on your brief).

access.description: Your passing answer to the earlier “access” lab.
